invariants.description: Every captured payment has a confirmed order within 2 minutes
Every new order is picked up for processing within 2 minutes
Ledger rows respect VAT = 15% of amount and total = amount + VAT
No paid order waits for supplier approval longer than 5 minutes
Each order is charged at most once
No task is retried beyond its retry budget
Payment failures stay under 5% of attempts in the last 5 minutes
